rationale: Three-lens review (blind, edge-case, acceptance) found no blocking issues. All 8 acceptance criteria from plan.md Review Focus / Global Constraints pass. Two minor non-blocking observations (deferred): (1) get_session_durations' SQL coalesce lacks a final ',0' fallback that get_session_detail_meta has, but every consumer wraps the value in _i() which maps None->0, so no behavioral gap exists today; (2) the handler's session_duration_ms fallback branch is not explicitly clamped with max(0, ...) the way the hook-pair branch is, a theoretical risk only if the rollup ever produced a negative duration. Neither affects current correctness, security, or the stated acceptance criteria. Diff is minimal (155 lines incl. tests), scoped exactly to the plan's 4 tasks, commits follow ticket format, no new deps/migrations, started_at/last_event_at window-membership logic untouched.

get_sessions list view unaffected when session_duration_ms key absent from mock row
duration_ms REST fields stay int (not nullable); final fallback stays 0

No new third-party deps, no new migration
